snippet.title: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux | Announcement Trailer | PS5, Xbox Series X|S & Steam - November 26
snippet.description:
The Spectrum Retreat: Redux comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam on 26th November 2026. Out now on Nintendo Switch 2.

Wishlist now:
- PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10021069
- Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/the-spectrum-retreat-redux/9p5vj0rmz6m0

Redux is a ground-up rebuild of Dan Smith's BAFTA-winning first-person puzzle game.

You're a guest at The Penrose, an art-deco hotel cut off from the outside world and run by android staff. With only a stranger's voice to guide you, you start trying to work out why you're there. To get through the hotel you absorb and swap colours to pass security barriers and redirect energy. Underneath it all is a story about memory, grief and a family let down by the systems that were meant to protect them.

New on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC:
- Rebuilt lighting with ray-traced reflections and volumetrics
- 4K resolution, plus Performance and Quality Modes on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
- Express Checkout: a new puzzle speedrun mode
- Enhanced 5.1 surround sound
- Chapter select, faster traversal, and performance and gameplay improvements

Pricing:
£9.99 / $12.99 / €12.99

Developed by Dan Smith Studios and Ripstone.
Published by Ripstone.
